name: GoReNinja
author: Alessandro Saba
description: Go reversing toolkit with function, type, interface, build-info and IL-aware decompilation recovery
longdescription:
GoReNinja is a substantially expanded fork of GoLang binary parser, originally created by Jacopo Ferrigno (https://github.com/dipusone/golang_pclntab_parser) under the MIT license. It parses a Go binary and restores information like:

- Location of the `.gopclntab`/`__gopclntab` section by name, or by searching for its magic when the section is missing or renamed
- Function names, also organized in components
- Source file (and line) comments on the functions
- Go type definitions, as annotated Go types or native Binary Ninja types
- Optional typelink enumeration, Go 1.27 serialized type descriptors, and interface recovery through itablinks or Go 1.27 contiguous itabs
- Go build info and the list of source files included in the binary
- Import of GoReSym JSON output (user and standard-library functions), or running GoReSym and importing it

Supported pclntab layouts: Go 1.2, 1.16, 1.18 and 1.20+. Type recovery is best tested on Go 1.16+ binaries.
